rules.topic: Rocket fuel: the tank holds 3000 mB; one launch consumes 3000 mB of a normal fuel or 1000 mB of a fuel in the efficient_fuel tag, so a full tank is exactly 1 launch on normal fuel or 3 launches on efficient fuel

rules.quote: public record Planet( ResourceKey<Level> dimension, boolean oxygen, short temperature, float gravity, int solarPower, ResourceLocation solarSystem, Optional<ResourceKey<Level>> orbit, int tier, List<ResourceKey<Level>> additionalLaunchDimensions )
rules.topic: Every planet entry carries a required rocket tier; the launch menu only offers planets whose tier is <= the rocket's tier (tier 1 rocket: Earth orbit and Moon; tier 2 adds Mars; tier 3 adds Venus and Mercury; tier 4 adds Glacio)

Default planet data (jar datapack files under data/ad_astra/planets/, packs may override): Moon tier 1, oxygen false, temperature -173, gravity 1.622, solar power 24; Mars tier 2, oxygen false, -65, 3.72076, 12; Venus tier 3, oxygen false, 464, 8.87, 8; Mercury tier 3, oxygen false, 167, 3.7, 64; Glacio tier 4, oxygen TRUE, -20, 3.721, 14

Suffocation: in an area without oxygen, a living entity that is not wearing a full oxygen-supplying armor set (and is not in an oxygenated volume) takes 2 oxygen damage per environment tick and its air supply is forced down; a full space suit set with oxygen in its tanks fully prevents this

rules.quote: // Every 12 ticks = 10 minutes per 1,000 mB (1 bucket) oxygen
rules.topic: Space suit oxygen use: while the surroundings have no oxygen, the chestplate consumes 1 unit of tank oxygen every 12 ticks; by the code's own conversion 1000 mB of oxygen lasts about 10 minutes, so suit endurance scales linearly with total tank size across the set

value.consumption: 1 unit per 12 ticks in unbreathable surroundings

rules.quote: public static final int MIN_LIVEABLE_TEMPERATURE = -50; public static final int MAX_LIVEABLE_TEMPERATURE = 70;
rules.topic: Liveable temperature band is -50 to 70 (planet temperature scale); outside it, entities take temperature damage unless wearing the matching full resistant armor set (heat resistant for hot, freeze resistant for cold) or fire resistance for heat

Temperature damage per environment application: hot planets deal 6 on-fire damage and set the entity on fire for 10 seconds; cold planets deal 3 freeze damage and add freezing ticks (freeze damage line at 117 of the same file)

A rocket that crashes explodes with power 7 + 2 x its tier (tier 1 = 9, tier 4 = 15) when the impact is not in an oxygenated area check passes; landing pads and controlled descent are not optional for high tiers

Solar panels generate the current planet's solar_power value per tick during the day (planet data field solar_power: Moon 24, Mars 12, Venus 8, Mercury 64, Glacio 14); the same panel is worth 8x more on Mercury than on Venus
Oxygen and temperature systems each have a config kill switch (disableOxygen, disableTemperature); quoted survival numbers assume both are off (the defaults)
